title: Hai Jahan me aaj Maatam Haidare Karrar ka
body:
ALLAH O AKBAR..
SUB'HAANA RABBI UL AALA WA BE HAMDE'H.
QAD QUTELAL MURTUZA...**2.
HAIN JAHAN MEIN AAJ MATAM HYDER E KARRAR ASWS. KA.
SAR PE MOULA KE SITAM YEH AY QUDA JJH. KAISA HUA.
1. HOKE ZAQMI MASJIDE
KOOFA SE AAYE HAIN ALI ASWS....**2.
THAAM KAR SAR MUZTARIB HAIN QALQ KA MUSHKILKUSHA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. SABKO SHABBAR ASWS. KE HAWALE.
KARTE HAIN MOULA ALI ASWS...**2.
FATIMA ZEHRA S.A. KA GHAR AB BAN GAYA MATAM SARAA..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. KYA QAYAMAT AAYI HAIN
EKKEESWEEN(21wi) RAMZAN KO..**2.
QAT QUTELAL MURTUZA ASWS. JIBREEL DETE HAIN SADA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. ROTE HAIN HASNAIN O KULSOOM S.A. AUR ZAINAB ASWS. ZAAR ZAAR..**2.
KARTE HAI FARYAAD SABSE MARGAYA BABA MERA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. BAANT-TA THA ROTIYA'N
RAATO'N KO UTHKE SABKE GHAR...**2.
HAAYE BEWO'N KA YATEEMO'N KA SAHARA NA RAHA.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. AB JANAZA JAA RAHA HAIN
HASHR HAIN HAR SOO BAPA...**2
AY SOHAIL IS GHAM SE HAIN MAGHMOOM KUFE KI FIZA.
Kalaam: JANAB RAZA ALI SOHAIL SAHAB.
